## AMD releases first official EPYC 'Venice' benchmarks claiming performance leadership over Nvidia Vera in AI server CPUs

If Venice benchmark claims hold under independent review, AMD could take AI server CPU socket share from Nvidia's Vera; even competitive pressure alone gives hyperscalers negotiating leverage and supports AMD's TAM expansion narrative in AI infrastructure.

- AMD published company-supplied benchmarks for its EPYC Venice CPU, directly targeting Nvidia's Vera CPU in AI server workloads.
- AMD claims its 256-core Venice chip is more than twice as fast as Nvidia Vera on the tested workloads.
- AMD also claims the 96-core Venice model is 20% faster per-core than Nvidia Vera.
- These are vendor-supplied figures; independent third-party validation has not been reported in the coverage.
